projectDescription: A conversational Text-to-SQL AI assistant that lets business users query SAP/ERP financial data in natural language, powered by LangGraph, AWS Bedrock (Claude), and a React chat interface.
keyFeatures: Natural language to SQL conversion over SAP/ERP data (Spanish)
Two-level LangGraph pipeline: outer conversation graph + inner SQL pipeline
Automatic chart generation (bar, line, pie, horizontal bar, stacked bar) and KPI cards
Self-correcting SQL with up to 3 retry attempts via error handler node
Human-in-the-loop (HITL) confirmation for expensive or destructive queries
Role-based access control (RBAC) with per-module data permissions
Multi-tenant isolation: each customer gets its own instance with tenant-scoped RBAC
Short-term session memory (Redis) + long-term conversation history (DynamoDB, 90-day TTL)
Semantic schema linking with FAISS vector store + Amazon Titan V2 embeddings
File upload analysis (Excel/CSV) with code execution sandbox
Prometheus metrics + Grafana dashboards + LangSmith tracing
AWS Cognito JWT authentication with rate limiting (slowapi)
publicApiSurface: POST /chat — submit a question; returns SQL, chart config, KPIs, and narrative
WebSocket /ws/chat — streaming chat with per-node progress events
GET /health — health check (DB connectivity + feature flags)
GET /metrics — Prometheus-format metrics scrape endpoint
GET /schema/tables — list all ERP tables in the schema registry
GET /schema/tables/{table_name} — detailed table metadata (columns, DDL, business notes)
POST /schema/search — semantic search over table descriptions
GET /api/me — current user identity, role, permissions, and modules
GET /api/admin/users — list Cognito users (admin only)
POST /api/admin/users — create a Cognito user (admin only)
GET /api/admin/users/{username} — user detail including groups and modules
PUT /api/admin/users/{username} — update user attributes
DELETE /api/admin/users/{username} — delete user
POST /api/admin/users/{username}/groups — add user to Cognito group
DELETE /api/admin/users/{username}/groups/{group} — remove user from group
POST /api/admin/users/{username}/modules — assign data modules to user
POST /api/admin/users/{username}/instances — assign tenant instances to user
GET /api/admin/costs — LLM token cost summary (global, by user, by node)
GET /api/instances — list tenant instances (admin only)
POST /api/instances — provision a new tenant instance
POST /api/upload — upload Excel/CSV file for analysis
